slot-dd7aa79a-d925-4a97-b6f4-addb9ac98ec.quote_span: When asked to select which category of people they most associated with courage, just 4 percent of Americans picked elected officials — tying with social media influencers, according to newly-published Gallup survey results.

edges.reason: Both quotes report the same value (4 percent) for the same metric (people associating courage with elected officials) from the same source (Gallup survey results) within the same article on The Hill.

edges.sentence: On 2026-10-01, The Hill reported “Only 4 percent of respondents picked “elected leaders in the U.S. government” as a group they saw as most linked to courage, tying with influencers and passing up both business leaders and athletes — which 2 percent of those polled associated with the trait.”; on the same day, The Hill reported “When asked to select which category of people they most associated with courage, just 4 percent of Americans picked elected officials — tying with social media influencers, according to newly-published Gallup survey results.”.
